note: 0.1.7 D-81 (critique 7): SessionStart of an installed copy (Claude Code's plugin cache layout) writes ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/<plugin>/bin/<plugin>-store, a #!/bin/sh exec of its own launcher (temp + rename, 0755), which runs `cache` under sh; it points it here again when its target is gone or older, keeps one that runs a newer version that still exists, and leaves a file that is not such a shim (the user's own) alone. XDG_STATE_HOME moves it.

steps.name: the shim runs cache under sh
the same again: left as it is
a shim whose target is gone: pointed here again
a shim of an older version that still exists: pointed here
a shim of a newer version that still exists: kept
a file of the user's own there: left alone
a compaction's SessionStart: the shim is not checked
